# JAPANIST

> JAPANIST is a customized Japanese language learning platform offering one-on-one tutoring with native teachers, specializing in beginner to advanced courses, JLPT exam preparation, business Japanese, and cultural training.

JAPANIST provides online Japanese lessons tailored to individual learners, from children to professionals, with flexible scheduling and multiple course specializations. The platform emphasizes native teacher instruction and personalized learning approaches to help students achieve their language goals.

## Key Topics

- Japanese language learning
- Native Japanese teachers
- One-on-one tutoring
- JLPT preparation
- Business Japanese
- Online lessons
- Customized courses
- Free trial lessons
- Japanese cultural education
- Conversational practice
- Children's Japanese courses
- Referral programs
- ZOOM platform
- Tokyo-based instruction
- Language certification
